description: This file is a shell script used for orchestrating end-to-end testing of cross-platform updates in a parallelized environment, especially involving VM-based testing of a software package (likely openclaw). It manages VM resolution, package packaging, running smoke tests on Mac, Windows, and Linux VMs, and performing updates, with detailed logging and JSON output capabilities.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Outputs a message with a prefix '==>' for status updates.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message prefixed with 'warn:' to stderr.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks, including killing server process and removing temporary directories.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: resolve_linux_vm_name
methods.description: Resolves the Linux VM name based on requested version, using a Python script to match and select the best VM.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Resolves the latest version of openclaw from npm registry.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects the host IP address for the VM host.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Allocates an available network port for serving files.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Runs package build command 'pnpm build' for current source.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Packages the current Git HEAD into a tarball and points to its path.

methods.name: write_windows_update_script
methods.description: Creates a PowerShell script for Windows updates within the package.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Serves the packaged tarball over HTTP on a dynamically assigned port.

methods.name: wait_job
methods.description: Waits for a background process to complete, providing logging on failure.

methods.name: extract_log_progress
methods.description: Parses logs to extract current progress status for long-running jobs.

methods.name: dump_log_tail
methods.description: Outputs the tail end of a specified log file for debugging.

methods.name: monitor_jobs_progress
methods.description: Monitors multiple background jobs, reporting progress periodically.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Extracts the last reported openclaw version from logs.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Runs a PowerShell script inside a Windows VM via guest agent.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Executes commands with a host-side timeout.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Polls guest PowerShell execution with a timeout.

methods.name: run_windows_script_via_log
methods.description: Runs a Windows update script inside VM, monitoring logs and status.

methods.name: run_macos_update
methods.description: Runs a macOS update procedure inside its VM.

methods.name: run_windows_update
methods.description: Runs a Windows update procedure inside its VM.

methods.name: run_linux_update
methods.description: Runs a Linux update procedure inside its VM.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Outputs a JSON summary report containing update statuses and versions.
